context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
#4307 flagged 12 TPC-DI bundles produced by an older generator with `defective-variant-or-loader-wrong-result`, whose canonical text says the run produced wrong values. They are only from an older generator; a custom `known_defect_reason` overrides the displayed text.

## Change
Propose a label id and text for 'produced by a superseded data generator; not comparable with current bundles', then relabel the 12 sidecars.

## Decision gates
The owner approves the label id and text before anything is committed: defect labels are public corpus taxonomy and appear in the Explorer. Check how the site renders an unknown label before proposing an id.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the 12 sidecars carry the approved label; bundle bytes and hashes are unchanged; corpus validation and the inventory check pass; ranking exclusion of the 12 is unchanged.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
